authority.configuration: Four parked SDS L2 modules and four locally bolted 16-article terminal cartridges

scope: Matched mass ledger and original governing stiffness, hit, load route and traction. Added ties use a 25.4 × 50.8 × 3.175 mm 6061 tube on horizontal centerlines and ideal rigid end connections. Stock substitution changes stiffness only at fixed total comparison mass. Gross tube weights exclude fasteners. The 1000× case is a limit control. No spatial fit, fatigue, screw engagement or complete frame release is demonstrated.
